Settings.QueryText:
SELECT RoomsAvailable.Room AS Room, RoomsAvailable.Room.SortCode AS RoomSortCode, RoomsAvailable.Room.BedsSetup AS BedsSetup, RoomsAvailable.RoomType AS RoomType, RoomsAvailable.RoomPropertiesCodes AS RoomPropertiesCodes, RoomsAvailable.RoomStatusIconIndex AS RoomStatusIconIndex, RoomsAvailable.RoomsVacant AS RoomsVacant, RoomsAvailable.BedsVacant AS BedsVacant, RoomsAvailable.CounterBalance AS CounterBalance, ISNULL(RoomsVacantFrom.VacantFromDate, &qEmptyDate) AS VacantFromDate FROM (SELECT RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.Room AS Room, RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.RoomType AS RoomType, CAST(RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.Room.RoomPropertiesCodes AS STRING(100)) AS RoomPropertiesCodes, ISNULL(RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.Room.RoomStatus.IconIndex, 5) AS RoomStatusIconIndex, MIN(RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.RoomsVacantClosingBalance) AS RoomsVacant, MIN(RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.BedsVacantClosingBalance) AS BedsVacant, MAX(RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.CounterClosingBalance) AS CounterBalance FROM AccumulationRegister.RoomInventory.BalanceAndTurnovers( &qBeginOfPeriod, &qEndOfPeriod, Minute, RegisterRecordsAndPeriodBoundaries, Hotel = &qHotel AND RoomType IN HIERARCHY (&qRoomType) AND NOT &qUseAllotmentBalances AND (&qRoomStatusIsEmpty OR NOT &qRoomStatusIsEmpty AND Room.RoomStatus = &qRoomStatus) AND (NOT &qFilterByProperties OR &qFilterByProperties AND Room IN (&qRoomsWithProperties)) AND (NOT &qFilterByAllotmentRoomsList OR &qFilterByAllotmentRoomsList AND Room IN (&qAllotmentRoomsList))) AS RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers
GROUP BY RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.Room, RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.RoomType, CAST(RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.Room.RoomPropertiesCodes AS STRING(100)), ISNULL(RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.Room.RoomStatus.IconIndex, 5)
HAVING (&qAll OR &qByRooms AND MIN(RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.RoomsVacantClosingBalance) > 0 OR NOT &qByRooms AND MIN(RoomInventoryBalanceAndTurnovers.BedsVacantClosingBalance) > 0)
UNION ALL
SELECT RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.Room, RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.RoomType, CAST(RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.Room.RoomPropertiesCodes AS STRING(100)), ISNULL(RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.Room.RoomStatus.IconIndex, 5), MIN(RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.RoomsRemainsClosingBalance), MIN(RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.BedsRemainsClosingBalance), MAX(RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.CounterClosingBalance) FROM AccumulationRegister.RoomQuotaSales.BalanceAndTurnovers( &qBeginOfPeriod, &qEndOfPeriod, Minute, RegisterRecordsAndPeriodBoundaries, Hotel = &qHotel AND RoomQuota = &qAllotment AND RoomType IN HIERARCHY (&qRoomType) AND &qUseAllotmentBalances AND (&qRoomStatusIsEmpty OR NOT &qRoomStatusIsEmpty AND Room.RoomStatus = &qRoomStatus) AND (NOT &qFilterByProperties OR &qFilterByProperties AND Room IN (&qRoomsWithProperties))) AS RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers
GROUP BY RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.Room, RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.RoomType, CAST(RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.Room.RoomPropertiesCodes AS STRING(100)), ISNULL(RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.Room.RoomStatus.IconIndex, 5)
HAVING (&qAll OR &qByRooms AND MIN(RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.RoomsRemainsClosingBalance) > 0 OR NOT &qByRooms AND MIN(RoomQuotaSalesBalanceAndTurnovers.BedsRemainsClosingBalance) > 0)) AS RoomsAvailable LEFT JOIN (SELECT LastRoomDocuments.Room AS Room, MAX(LastRoomDocuments.CheckOutDate) AS VacantFromDate FROM AccumulationRegister.RoomInventory AS LastRoomDocuments WHERE LastRoomDocuments.Hotel = &qHotel AND LastRoomDocuments.RoomType IN HIERARCHY(&qRoomType) AND LastRoomDocuments.CheckOutDate < &qBeginOfPeriod
GROUP BY LastRoomDocuments.Room) AS RoomsVacantFrom ON (RoomsVacantFrom.Room = RoomsAvailable.Room) WHERE NOT RoomsAvailable.Room IN (&qSelectedRoomsList) AND (NOT &qFilterByBedsSetup OR &qFilterByBedsSetup AND RoomsAvailable.Room.BedsSetup = &qBedsSetup)
